# Building Resilient Microservices

Modern distributed systems require careful attention to failure modes. This article explores three patterns — circuit breakers, bulkheads, and retry budgets — that prevent cascade failures in microservice architectures.

## Circuit Breaker Pattern

The circuit breaker monitors failure rates and trips open when errors exceed a threshold, preventing downstream overload.

## Bulkhead Pattern

Isolation boundaries limit the blast radius of failures to individual service partitions.
